scripts.title: ChurchCore Sovereign Control Plane: Deliberation Engine
scripts.description:
Generates intelligent, context-aware Council determinations, customized AntiGravity prompts,
and specialized member speeches tailored to the specific product and feature requested.
Permanently logs ratified executive deliberations into docs/deliberations/.
scripts.cat_summary: Utility script for sovereign control plane automation.

scripts.title: ChurchCore Sovereign Control Plane: Local Dashboard Server
scripts.description:
Serves the Executive Cockpit locally at http://localhost:3333,
including live documentation, markdown dossiers, and telemetry files.
scripts.cat_summary: Serves the real-time glassmorphic dashboard and documentation dossier viewer at http://localhost:3333.

scripts.title: ChurchCore Sovereign Control Plane: Proactive Repository Activation Engine
scripts.description:
Installs governance rules, acknowledgment ledgers, telemetry reporting scripts,
and initializes factual edge telemetry across all 6 sibling product repositories.
scripts.cat_summary: Proactively injects governance rules, acknowledgment ledgers, edge scripts, and docs/mvp-100-plan.md.

scripts.title: ChurchCore Sovereign Control Plane: Autonomous Edge Challenge & Evidence Engine
scripts.description:
Enables any product repository to autonomously challenge, dispute, or update stale/incorrect
central control plane information or mark MVP roadmap features complete by providing
verifiable cryptographic, git, HTTP, file, or test evidence.
scripts.cat_summary: CLI enabling edge repositories to challenge central records with verifiable cryptographic proof.
cli_flags: Feature number or title to mark complete (e.g. 1 or 'Feature 1')
Commit SHA proving feature or field update
Explicit field path to challenge (e.g. online_status.is_online)

scripts.title: ChurchCore Sovereign Control Plane: Central Telemetry Aggregator & Dashboard Engine
scripts.description:
Ingests edge telemetry from all 6 product repositories, validates against schema,
and compiles the live master executive dashboard (ECOSYSTEM-DASHBOARD.md).
scripts.cat_summary: Ingests edge telemetry from all 6 product repositories and compiles the master ecosystem dashboard.

scripts.title: ChurchCore Sovereign Control Plane: Automated Daily Fleet Briefing Engine
scripts.description:
Inspects all 6 sibling product repositories, analyzes 24-hour commit logs,
synchronizes edge telemetry, verifies governance invariants, and generates
an executive briefing report.
scripts.cat_summary: Automated daily fleet status, MVP 100% progress tracking, and morning priority queue generation.

scripts.title: ChurchCore Sovereign Control Plane: Marketing & Business Presentation Engine
scripts.description:
Generates dynamic, living presentation decks and AI prompt packets (Claude, ChatGPT, Prezi AI, PromptAI)
synchronized directly from live repository telemetry, git commit history, schema metrics, and screenshots.
scripts.cat_summary: Generates slide decks and AI prompt packets (Claude, Gemini, Antigravity) from product dossiers.

scripts.title: ChurchCore Sovereign Control Plane: Automated Python Automation Catalog Generator
scripts.description:
Scans scripts/ and dashboard/ for Python scripts, extracts AST docstrings,
CLI usage patterns, and argument parser definitions, and automatically compiles
docs/control-plane/PYTHON-SCRIPTS-CATALOG.md.

Runs automatically on fleet sync and daily briefings.
scripts.cat_summary: Utility script for sovereign control plane automation.

scripts.title: ChurchCore Project Management Task CLI
scripts.description: Allows listing, adding, updating, and syncing tasks between tasks.json and PROJECT_TASKS.md.
scripts.cat_summary: Bidirectional task management CLI between docs/control-plane/tasks.json and PROJECT_TASKS.md.

scripts.title: ChurchCore Sovereign Control Plane: Edge Directive Ingestion & Enforcement Engine
scripts.description:
Runs inside any ChurchCore product repository to pull down central directives,
execute automated compliance audits, update ACKNOWLEDGMENTS.md, and enforce governance.
scripts.cat_summary: Runs inside edge product repos to pull central directives and enforce compliance invariants.
cli_flags: Exit with code 1 if any critical directive fails

scripts.title: ChurchCore Sovereign Control Plane: Central Evidence Verification & Reconciliation Engine
scripts.description:
Autonomously verifies evidence provided by edge product repositories challenging central records.
When evidence is validated, updates central telemetry, councils registry, and immediately mutates
both central records AND edge repository instructions (docs/mvp-100-plan.md), advancing the active
directive to prevent infinite command-and-challenge loops.
scripts.cat_summary: Autonomously audits edge challenge evidence and updates the central reconciliation ledger.

scripts.title: ChurchCore Sovereign Control Plane: Universal Edge Telemetry Reporter
scripts.description:
Updates docs/control-plane/telemetry.json for reporting to ChurchCore-Business Control Plane.
Can be executed with explicit flags or with --auto for continuous post-test/post-commit sync.
scripts.cat_summary: Standardized session logger for AI agents, recording duration, models, bug fixes, and errors.
cli_flags: Autonomously probe live endpoints, detect git commits, and record telemetry
Clear all blockers from readiness assessment

scripts.title: ChurchCore Governance Sync Engine
scripts.description:
---------------------------------
Generic cross-repository governance synchronization script.
Reads `docs/governance-sync/manifest.json`, queries product repositories on GitHub
(or local sibling folders as fallback), parses their `docs/council/ACKNOWLEDGMENTS.md`,
and updates `docs/governance-sync/COMPLIANCE-MATRIX.md`.
scripts.cat_summary: Syncs council decisions, validates manifest discovery, and verifies edge repository alignment.
